description: Returns a normalized booking handoff link for a source-linked independent Orange County, CA car-rental provider; it never creates or confirms a reservation. Use when: the user has selected a provider and wants its official booking or contact handoff for specific rental dates and, optionally, a vehicle type. Do not use when: the user needs WhichAgent to create or confirm a reservation, take payment, guarantee a real-time price or inventory, find national chains or franchises, or serve a category outside car rentals.

business_id.description: Required stable business ID returned by search.

pickup_date.description: Required pickup date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

return_date.description: Required return date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

vehicle_type.description: Optional requested vehicle type or class, such as SUV or exotic.

name: book
title: Get Car Rental Booking Handoff
